AI Market Pulse · November 2026

The month in the AI market: five moves that mattered, the latest funding numbers, what the labs shipped, new entrants, customer signals, and a check on our 2027 predictions.

7 ↑lab announcements in Nov (to 18th)
11 ↑model releases in Nov

Key takeawaysTop five movesThe month in numbersFundingNew entrants and open weightsCustomer signalsPredictions check-inMethod and sources

⚡ Key takeaways

💡
  1. OpenAI shipped GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (17 Nov), with lower API prices and a reported High rating for AI self-improvement.
  2. Google made Gemini 4 Hydrogen its fast default (12 Nov); Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and a restricted Mythos 5.2 (9 Nov).
  3. Alibaba's Qwen4-Max launched closed (16 Nov) while Thinking Machines opened Inkling 2 Small's weights (12 Nov): open and closed are not sorted by country.
  4. Latest reported funding quarter: about $102B for AI in Q3 2026, 64% of all venture money.
  5. No predictions are due yet; the first checks are in June 2027.

📊 The month in numbers

🔧 Reproduce this: pulse.py
pulse.py · reads the site's data files; change MONTH for the next issue
"""pulse.py — AI Market Pulse, monthly issue: counts the month from the site's own data.

Reads data/lab-updates.json, data/model-releases.json, data/ai-investments.json and
data/predictions-2027.json. Prints this month's lab announcements by lab, releases by
modality and open share, the latest reported funding quarter, and predictions due.
Change MONTH to produce the next issue. Standard library only.
"""
import json, os
MONTH = "2026-11"
D = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "..")
lu = json.load(open(os.path.join(D, "lab-updates.json")))["items"]
mr = json.load(open(os.path.join(D, "model-releases.json")))["items"]
iv = json.load(open(os.path.join(D, "ai-investments.json")))
pr = json.load(open(os.path.join(D, "predictions-2027.json")))["items"]
CUTOFF = "2026-11-17"  # last data date before this issue was published (18 Nov); later items belong to the next issue
items = [x for x in lu if str(x["date"]).startswith(MONTH) and str(x["date"]) <= CUTOFF]
by = {}
for x in items: by[x["lab"]] = by.get(x["lab"], 0) + 1
print(f"{MONTH}: {len(items)} lab announcements, {sum(1 for x in items if x.get('flagship'))} flagship")
print("  by lab: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in sorted(by.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])))
rel = [x for x in mr if str(x["date"]).startswith(MONTH) and str(x["date"]) <= CUTOFF]
mods = {}
for x in rel:
    for m in x["mod"]: mods[m] = mods.get(m, 0) + 1
print(f"  model releases: {len(rel)} ({', '.join(f'{k} {v}' for k, v in sorted(mods.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]))}); open-weight {sum(1 for x in rel if x.get('open') in (1, 2))}")
q = iv["quarters"][-1]
print(f"latest funding quarter reported: {q['q']} ${q['total']}B ({q['by']})")
due = [p for p in pr if p["check"] <= MONTH]
print(f"predictions due by {MONTH}: {len(due)} of {len(pr)}; next check {min(p['check'] for p in pr)}")
$ python3 pulse.py 2026-11: 7 lab announcements, 4 flagship by lab: openai 3, qwen 1, google 1, anthropic 1, meta 1 model releases: 11 (llm 8, speech 1, video 1, image 1); open-weight 1 latest funding quarter reported: 2026-Q3 $102B (Crunchbase) predictions due by 2026-11: 0 of 10; next check 2027-06

November covers 1–18 Nov at the time of writing.

🧭 Funding

  • Latest reported quarter.
    • Q3 2026: about $102B for AI, 64% of global venture funding (Crunchbase); CB Insights: $103.3B, down 33% from Q2 ⚠️.
    • Largest tracked rounds: OpenAI $10B, Databricks $5B, SSI $5B, Crusoe $3.9B, Cognition $2B (reported). Live list on the AI Market Map.

🔍 New entrants and open weights

  • This month.
    • Thinking Machines added to the Model Release Map with Inkling 2 Small's open weights.
    • ElevenLabs Scribe v3 and Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash extended speech and video tiers.

⚖️ Customer signals

  • Steady, not new.
    • 2026 surveys still put integration and governance ahead of model quality as blockers (Brief 4).

🔮 Predictions check-in

  • Nothing due yet.
    • Evidence for prediction 3 (self-improvement ratings) strengthened with GPT-6.2 Astra.
    • Evidence for prediction 6 (restricted tiers) strengthened with Mythos 5.2.

📄 Method and sources

  • Lab moves from the Frontier Lab Updates and Model Release Map (sourced).
  • Funding as reported by Crunchbase and CB Insights ⚠️.
  • Monthly counts from pulse.py; next issue: December 2026.
